blocks.text:
Swipe between Home pages and they move in 3D instead of sliding flat. Cube folds each page away around its edge, like the side of a box, and Inside Cube folds them toward you, like the walls of a room. Carousel turns them a little and steps them back as they leave, like cards passing a window, and Stack steps them back without turning. Flipbook's page in Settings › Tweaks picks which one.

It stays out of the way when it should. Pages slide flat while you drag an app or resize a widget, and Reduce Motion turns it off altogether.

Flipbook is for supporters first, while the beta decides whether its effects are smooth enough at 120 Hz. Everyone gets it in Folio 0.6.8.

Inspired by Barrel by Aaron Ash and Cylinder by Reed Weichler: Inside Cube is Cylinder's Cube (inside), and Stack is Page Squeeze by Beta382 for Cylinder. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.

items: Cube, Inside Cube, Carousel or Stack, chosen on Flipbook's page
Flat again while you move an app or a widget
Nothing at all when it's switched off
